reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Obstetrical Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Cesarean delivery is included in the global obstetrical package when the same group provides antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care. When the full package is billed, the cesarean delivery component is not separately reimbursed.

pairing_conditions: when submitted with assistant surgeon modifier

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: For Commercial CA maternity claims, bundle CPT 59510 to one unit once per pregnancy when billed on the same claim and same TIN/group as the global OB package; apply the usual 13 prenatal visits construct to prevent duplicate 59510 package payment. Apply to CA. Exempt: assistant surgeons for cesarean deliveries. Peer: United Health bundles 59510 in the Commercial global OB package for the same group at one unit, and Cigna includes 59510 within the Commercial global maternity/obstetric package..

Recommendation 2: For Commercial CA cesarean delivery CPT 59514 and 59620, allow separate reimbursement only for assistant surgeon billing when modifier 80, 81, 82, or AS is on the same claim line / submitted with assistant surgeon modifier; otherwise bundle into the global OB package. Apply to CA. Peer: Cigna requires modifiers 80, 81, 82, or AS for assistant surgeon billing, and United Health separately reimburses 59514/59620 only when submitted with an assistant surgeon modifier within the Commercial global OB package..
